SASMAP-15mC (*Systems Approach to Shared Mobility, Accessibility and Proximity for 15 Minute Cities*) builds an evidence base for a step change in car sharing as an alternative to private car ownership. The project combines system analysis, household-level mobility data, quantitative modelling and co-design in living labs in Bristol (UK), Graz (Austria) and Helsingborg (Sweden).

::: {.mz-facts}
Funding
: DUT Partnership (Call 2024); Austrian part funded by FFG

Duration
: December 2025 – May 2028

Coordinator
: University of the West of England (UWE Bristol)

My role
: Lead of work package 2 – qualitative system analysis: stakeholder mapping, causal loop diagrams (CLDs) and leverage points

Interactive
: [Consolidated causal loop diagram](../assets/interactive/sasmap-cld.html)
:::
